security_seniority_definition_003_eviden: Seniority shall mean the status of teachers with respect to the length of teaching service with the District as follows: Seniority shall be computed from an employee’s most recent date of employment. Part-time employment shall be included on a pro-rata basis. For teachers new to teaching (TNT), seniority shall be computed from the most recent date of employment, excluding any days of TNT training prior to the start of the school year.
security_voluntary_transfer_004_answer: Voluntary transfers are generally not considered after July 1 for the ensuing school year. Employees are guaranteed consideration via an interview for any position they request (unless lacking proper certification/license). Vacancies are posted weekly via intranet/voice-mail for one week; employees must call the site administrator within two working days to schedule an interview. Selection is based on qualifications, with district seniority as a tiebreaker. After five interviews or two consecutive years without a transfer, employees may request Assistant Superintendent assistance. Vacancies occurring after July 1 are considered if they provide additional remuneration. Multi-site teachers may request single-site reassignment if a vacancy occurs between July 1 and August 1 (request due by June 30).
